ws_address.description: IP address or hostname to bind the Cockpit web service to. Use `*` to listen on all network interfaces.

ws_port.description: TCP port on which the Cockpit web UI listens.

ws_tls.description: Enable TLS (HTTPS) encryption for Cockpit connections. Requires valid certificate and key paths.

ws_tls_cert.description: File path to the TLS certificate used for HTTPS. Must be readable by the `cockpit-ws` user.

ws_tls_key.description: File path to the TLS private key. Usually the same file as the certificate for self-signed certs. Must be secure and readable by `cockpit-ws`.

items.description: Allowed domain(s) for CORS requests (e.g., `https://example.com`). Use empty list to disable CORS.

ws_cors_domains.description: List of origins permitted to make cross-origin requests to Cockpit. Leave empty or omit to disable CORS.

login_banner.description: Show or hide the login banner (the small message box above the login form).

login_banner_text.default: Welcome to Cockpit — your server’s cockpit for Linux.
login_banner_text.description: Custom text shown on the login banner. Use `""` to suppress (if `Banner` is `true` but text should be empty).

session_timeout_minutes.description: Maximum session lifetime in minutes. Set to `0` to disable (not recommended for security).

session_idle_timeout_minutes.description: Minutes of inactivity before a session times out. Set to `0` to disable (not recommended).

session_max_per_user.description: Maximum number of concurrent sessions allowed per user. Set to `0` for unlimited.

session_recording_path.description: Absolute directory path where session recordings will be stored (e.g., `/var/log/cockpit`). Leave empty or omit to disable recording.

items.description: System user name to exclude from session recording. By default, `root` is excluded.

session_recording_exclude_users.description: List of usernames whose sessions should NOT be recorded, even if session recording is enabled.
